avoid_for: Corporate and financial contexts, calm minimal or premium brands, readable long-form editorial, and any interface needing restrained palettes or quiet UX — the screaming orange canvas and solid-block type overwhelm informational content.
best_for: Maximalist food and bakery brands, playful local-business landing pages, and loud promotional campaigns that want full-bleed chromatic energy — orange-and-yellow color bands, starburst badges, and circus-tent decoration as the brand.
name: Lamanna
palette_voice: Saturated Anger Orange (#ff4100) is the primary full-bleed canvas and section fill with Sun Yellow (#ffc700) display type and starburst badges on top; Blush Peach (#fdbeba) and Cream (#fee3c1) are calmer secondary bands that break the orange dominance; Royal Blue (#1573dd) appears only as a 1–2px outlined stroke on links and icons; Charcoal (#292a2c)/Obsidian (#000000) for text — flat saturated color bands, hard chromatic transitions instead of whitespace, zero blur.
signature_moves: Full-bleed color bands with hard chromatic transitions (orange → blush → yellow) as section dividers — no max-width container, no card padding, every element touches the viewport edge
Right Grotesk Spatial display at line-height 0.89 so headlines stack into dense solid slabs rather than airy type
3D drop-shadow headlines — a solid #ff4100 offset on #ffc700 text, no blur, built-in dimensional depth
Sun-yellow starburst product badges instead of rectangular cards — no shadows, just geometric sun shapes
Zigzag SVGs, pointing hands, and royal-blue outlined links as decorative punctuation; 0px radius everywhere

source.leading_note: variables.css 无 --leading-body，仅有 --leading-body-sm: 1（body-sm 18px 行高 1.0）；DESIGN.md 文字另有正文 22px/1.67 角色（无 token），生成时以 1.0 为契约锚点
source.shadow: none (no blur) — depth via hard color bands and solid offset type shadows only

tagline: Neon circus tent on a Naples sidewalk
typographic_voice: An ultra-wide, compressed-black display face (Right Grotesk Spatial, subst. Bowlby One SC/Tungsten Bold) at 36–54px with near-zero 0.89 leading makes headlines read as solid slabs; extended sans (Nimbus Sans) matches the tight 0.89 leading for body and subheadings, while Open Sans at 22px/1.67 is the quiet voice for longer passages; condensed semibold (Obviously Condensed) for punchy CTA labels.
